issues.issue: Does section 11(h) of the Charter protect against retrospective changes to sentence conditions constituting additional punishment?
issues.applicant_position: Retrospective repeal of early day parole eligibility is punitive and violates s. 11(h) right not to be punished again.
issues.respondent_position: Section 11(h) should be narrowly read to exclude elimination of early day parole eligibility as punishment; requires duplication of proceedings.
issues.result_text: Section 11(h) protects against being punished again even without a second proceeding.

issues.issue: Do retrospective changes to parole eligibility constitute 'punishment' under s. 11(h)?
issues.applicant_position: Retrospective delayed parole eligibility imposed by legislation constitutes punishment triggering s. 11(h).
issues.respondent_position: Retrospective repeal furthers rehabilitation and public safety, not punishment; changes to parole conditions are not punishment.
issues.result_text: Retrospective delayed parole eligibility imposed by legislation constitutes punishment under s. 11(h).

issues.issue: Is the retrospective repeal of APR provisions in s. 10(1) AEPA justified under s. 1 of the Charter?
issues.applicant_position: Retrospective repeal fails minimal impairment and is not justified; prospective repeal was available.
issues.respondent_position: Retrospective repeal furthers rehabilitation, reintegration, public safety, and confidence in justice system.
issues.result_text: Retrospective application fails minimal impairment and is not justified under s. 1.

issues.issue: Should the remedy be limited to only the delayed day parole eligibility aspect of s. 10(1) AEPA?
issues.applicant_position: Only delayed day parole eligibility infringed rights; other APR aspects should not be invalidated.
issues.respondent_position: No serious analysis on other APR aspects; delayed day parole eligibility is the key punishment.
issues.result_text: Full invalidity of s. 10(1) upheld; limited remedy not workable due to legislative dependencies.
